# Collective

> > Collective is an all-in-one financial platform for solopreneurs and small business owners, offering entity formation, bookkeeping, tax planning, and compliance solutions for LLCs and S Corps.

Collective provides integrated financial management tools specifically designed for self-employed professionals and solopreneurs. The platform combines business formation, accounting, and tax optimization services with tiered pricing plans and comprehensive educational resources.

## Pricing & Plans

- [Pricing for Solopreneurs | LLC & S Corp Plans | Collective](https://www.collective.com/plans-and-pricing): Pricing plans for LLC ($169/mo) and S Corp ($296/mo) with formation, bookkeeping, taxes.
